new_obligations.title: The proposed formal meaning needs an unambiguous interpretation
actions: Group every quantified clause; declare delta:C->D and matching payloads explicitly, with validation scope outside the disjunction.
Bind each required predicate/signature to an operational or selected formal interpretation.

Declare the assurance claim class and coverage: structural, finite interpreted model, owner fidelity review, or stronger supported proof. Do not rename a lexical/rationale check as formal non-collapse.
completion_criterion: Counterexamples: all references resolved with validation scope absent; unresolved reference without a declared gap; two differently worded statements with the same meaning.
Check interpretation against all three voices and declared neighboring/current definitions; record unsupported source clauses.
new_obligations.decision_guard: semantic promotion readiness and exact Definition owner decision

new_obligations.title: Key possession is not yet bound to the semantic principal
actions: Select an explicit trust root: the existing exact human owner-decision route, or a separately admitted principal/key enrollment or delegation binding.
Keep operator key, semantic principal, owner role, assignment and decision source independently represented.
Treat actor_ref, allowed_effects and user_confirmed as declarations unless their authentication basis is established. Do not create an authentication service merely to fill these fields.
completion_criterion: A valid local key with a copied definition-owner label is rejected for semantic promotion.
Unbound, rotated or revoked keys cannot make new effects; historical approved effects retain their exact recorded basis.
new_obligations.decision_guard: semantic authorization or repository application; read-only candidate work can proceed

new_obligations.title: Source parsing can use different bytes from the recorded digest
actions: Strictly decode/parse the exact byte buffer that was hashed; reject duplicate keys and nonfinite values from that buffer.
Read immutable selected epoch material or pin one snapshot/descriptor for the capture.
Carry parsed-content and file-byte identity consistently through source/reference validation.
completion_criterion: Planned controlled writer-interleaving case checks that parsed content always corresponds to the captured digest.
Persistent and transient source changes must cause a clean retry/failure or remain outside the pinned immutable snapshot.
new_obligations.decision_guard: using successor source capture as authorization evidence

new_obligations.title: Repository publication has no chosen coherent commit boundary
actions: Choose a concrete repository publication protocol: immutable epoch directory plus one accepted selection pointer, or another explicit staged/CAS protocol with a recoverable single visibility boundary.
Specify lock/CAS coverage, immutable preimages, reader snapshot selection and external-edit detection.
Keep schema/code/profile selection compatible throughout publication; do not describe independent per-file replacement as whole-repository atomicity.
completion_criterion: Planned reader-during-cutover, competing writer, stale preimage and crash-at-each-publication-step cases.
After recovery, readers see a complete old or complete new selected epoch, or an explicit unavailable state; no mixed state is labeled current.

new_obligations.title: The future source epoch depends on records not yet created
actions: Separate the manifest of immutable reviewed inputs from declared generated consequences and observed application receipts.
Authorize exact inputs, selected effects, deterministic generator/version and preconditions; identify legitimately post-decision fields explicitly.
Describe when final source-profile/selection bytes are materialized and how their authority derives, without a self-referential digest or second implicit approval.
completion_criterion: Fixture-dependent, predicted and observed digests cannot be substituted for each other.
A content-dependency graph distinguishes reviewed inputs, decision evidence and generated outputs; no output must hash itself.
new_obligations.decision_guard: freezing the adoption manifest and authorizing epoch advancement

new_obligations.title: Cross-runtime parsing and hash rules remain unspecified
actions: Choose one normative serialization/digest owner, or a fully specified shared serialization with numeric/string restrictions.
Distinguish raw-file hashes from normalized record digests and signature bytes.
Require strict duplicate-key rejection at external boundaries before JSON.parse discards duplicates; define allowed number precision and normalization explicitly.
completion_criterion: Planned cross-runtime cases: 1 versus 1.0, exponent forms, negative zero, unsafe integers, Unicode and numeric-looking keys.
Duplicate keys and unsupported nonfinite/precision values fail before review; source text and normalized content remain traceable.

new_obligations.title: Verification can precede a required binding and late documentation
actions: Add G02.05 as a dependency of G10.01.
Add a final documentation/adoption-closure check after G10.04 and before G10.05.
Bind every verification result to its input manifest; a later code, contract or behavior change reopens the relevant verification and invalidates affected decisions.
completion_criterion: Prototype verification cannot be ready while the realization binding is pending.
Exact documented CLI commands, relative links and stated behavior are checked on final selected bytes.
new_obligations.decision_guard: Product review and final adoption decisions

new_obligations.title: A completed decision task does not mean its outcome permits continuation
actions: Add explicit guards for qualifying Product approval and each independent owner effect.
Define revise -> new candidate epoch -> impacted verification -> new decision; defer/reject stop only the dependent branch.
Compute accepted-subset dependency closure and require an exact newly reviewable bundle when target membership or bytes change.
completion_criterion: Rejected/deferred Product or semantic outcomes never reach their dependent apply effect.
Partial selection preserves unselected targets; changed-byte requests cannot reuse an old decision/core/bundle.

new_obligations.title: Legacy compile and durable-session consumers need explicit adapters
actions: Choose an explicit supported route for every consumer: legacy preservation, versioned adapter, or visible unsupported result.
Retain compile-specific readiness unless an exact selected subset and compiler contract support it.
Specify identity/revision/lineage across conversions and saved session resume; do not coerce a new schema label to an old one.
completion_criterion: Planned old/new pack x prepare/compile/resume compatibility cases.
Open questions may be reviewable while unsupported compilation remains blocked; numeric/boolean Calculation regressions still run on the selected compiler.

new_obligations.title: Semantic revision impact is not closed over declared consumers
actions: Build an exact declared consumer/dependency impact manifest across current Definitions, carriers, profiles, policies, mappings, sessions and documentation.
For every affected reference select preserve-historical, proven-compatible, update, deprecate, block or explicitly deferred residue with owner.
Declare the scope of consistency/non-collapse assurance; current-source coverage and known interpretation gaps must remain visible rather than promising whole-repository proof.
completion_criterion: An incompatible declared dependent blocks current promotion/adoption until repaired or explicitly governed.
A preserved historical binding stays exact; it is not silently rewritten to the new current version.
new_obligations.decision_guard: a foundational Definition successor or any semantic revision admission

new_obligations.title: Pack and assurance work has no declared resource bounds
actions: Declare file/output bytes, concept count, reference depth, pair-check budget, history size and timeout limits for the intended release.
Use explicit batches and residue/continuation records when the full declared set exceeds a bound.
Never report full required-concept coverage after silent truncation.
completion_criterion: Boundary and over-limit inputs produce clear bounded outcomes.
Batch recomposition preserves full declared required-set identity and unresolved residue.
new_obligations.decision_guard: declaring production-like bounded operation or scaling beyond current fixtures

new_obligations.title: The first useful preview is tied to the entire authority implementation
actions: Declare three delivery milestones: read-only preparation preview; guarded exact review; authorized application with epoch/view refresh.
Freeze each candidate surface separately with exact limitations; keep the single final admission scope reviewable if that remains the selected interaction model.
Constrain the first writer/adapter to this Definition integration and defer general admission-platform work unless a concrete target requires it.
completion_criterion: The preview can be demonstrated without signing, stores, repository mutation or new authority.
Every milestone has a bounded accepted/deferred scope; partial delivery is never reported as full integration.
new_obligations.decision_guard: starting broad implementation scheduling; does not block draft review

outcome_guards: G10.03 permits downstream authority requests only for the qualifying Product approval outcome; revise/defer/reject have explicit continuation rules.
G10.06 requires all applicable independent exact member authorizations and current preconditions.
Changed target bytes or target-set membership require recomposed closure, impacted verification and fresh applicable decisions.
scope_rule: These are obligations to resolve, not mandatory new generic subsystems. Satisfy them with the existing exact human decision, source, protocol and publication surfaces where compatible.
